text:
Elaine: Mini-KVCache rollout complete — p50 down ~18% and estimated token cost -7% on hosted. TL;DR: enabled tiny local KV window + adaptive expiry on low-entropy routes. Monitoring for 24h. :tada:
Jordan: Awesome. Dashboard link? :eyes:
Elaine: Short dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dash/mini-kvcache-185 (internal). p50 84ms -> 69ms on text-gen workloads, cost/unit ~0.93x. Stress-tested with 3x surge, no tail regressions observed. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Product: Any impact on output quality or nondeterministic regressions? Evals pass?
Mira: Ran evals across our 12-prod prompt set — metrics are effectively identical. Found one edge case in translate-v2 with a small repeat increase; added route-level bypass to address it.
Sam: Rollout config snippet (rollback-ready):
```json
{"feature":"mini_kvcache_v1","regions":["us-east-1","eu-west-1"],"routes":{"default":{"enabled":true,"expiry_ms":250}},"bypass_labels":["translate-v2"]}
```
deploy-bot: deploy success — canary 2 -> 100% over ~45m. No error spikes; traces normal. Logs: s3://ci/deploy-1852467890.log
Elaine: Thanks team. Next actions: 1) schedule a 48h cost/regression review, 2) test increasing expiry for low-entropy chat routes, 3) add a kpi alert for per-route repetition. Posting a brief to release-notes and eng-runtime.
Jordan: Huge win — great work everyone :raised_hands:
